description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Denali Commission grant opportunities for rural Alaska infrastructure, energy, transportation, health facilities, sanitation, and housing. Eligible applicants are typically Alaska tribal, municipal, and nonprofit organizations, but eligibility varies by program. Filter by keyword or status. Present as information only; verify eligibility and deadlines against the official notice before acting. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
